items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dexter was around at the beginning of Bird... Dexter is a little slightly different than Bird... Dexter might be a little in between.

ctx.x: And how did you like his harmonic sense of movement and things, how was…
Well, his is slightly different, it’s not Bird, but it’s slightly different. He was around a long time, you know, Dexter was around at the beginning of Bird.
